r = gf.Component()

mmi1 = r.add_ref(gf.components.mmi1x2())

phase_shifter.move((0, 20.0))

mmi2 = r.add_ref(gf.components.mmi1x2())

gf.routing.route_bundle(

    [mmi1.ports['o2']],
    [phase_shifter.ports['o1']],
    cross_section='strip',
    radius=15.0,
    separation=15.0
)

# Route from phase_shifter to mmi2
gf.routing.route_bundle(
    r,
    [phase_shifter.ports['o2']],
    [mmi2.ports['o1']],

    radius=15.0,
    separation=15.0
)

    r,
    [mmi1.ports['o1']],
    [mmi2.ports['o2']],
    cross_section='strip',
    radius=15.0,
    separation=15.0
)

r.add_port('o1', port=mmi1.ports['o1'])
r.add_port('o2', port=mmi2.ports['o2'])
